claim_ceiling: No Luminous simulation, physical measurement, prototype, solver validation, or SOTA improvement is claimed.

records.title: Performance enhancement of electrohydrodynamic thruster using sub unit electrode configuration
records.reported_tradeoff: The article abstract explicitly reports a trade-off between absolute thrust and thrust-to-power ratio; absolute T/P values are not transcribed here.
missing_or_unverified: gas composition, humidity, pressure and temperature
current waveform and wall-plug power values
force measurement uncertainty and raw time series
records.comparability: Source-local comparison only. Do not combine its percentage gain with another paper or rank it against grid/guide/auxiliary-electrode studies without matched conditions.

records.title: Use of Guide Electrode for Increasing Thrust and Thrust-to-Power Ratio in Electroaerodynamic Propulsion Systems
records.configuration_change: A cylindrical guide electrode is placed above the emitter at the same potential.
records.reported_mechanism: The guide electrode reshapes the field toward the collector and suppresses ion leakage.
missing_or_unverified: exact voltage/current operating point for the maximum
full article tables and raw/supplementary data transcription
records.comparability: Source-local relative gain only. Do not infer absolute performance or combine with sub-unit/auxiliary/grid gains.

records.title: Controlled flight of high-thrust ultralight ion-propelled microrobot with integrated sensing
records.system_boundary: The demonstrated one-hour hover is tethered; the article discusses external/carrier power because the sub-gram platform cannot carry an adequate onboard power system. Do not classify this as self-powered free flight.
missing_or_unverified: complete onboard high-voltage conversion mass and energy budget
records.comparability: Integrated-system/control cohort; not a bare-thruster T/A or T/P comparator. Preserve tether and power-system boundaries.

records.title: Mechanism-guided prediction of energy efficiency enhancement in ion wind propulsion through ion mobility regulation
records.venue: International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer
records.interpretation_guard: The issue date is after the 2026-11-21 atlas date. Treat this as an accessible early/online source, not a final issue-date benchmark. The 100x mobility change is a model coordinate under a prescribed scaled-current condition, not an experimentally demonstrated independent control knob or propulsion improvement.
missing_or_unverified: final issue publication as of the atlas date
experimental validation of the predicted 100x mobility change under matched current and discharge conditions
full raw CFD and measurement data audit
records.comparability: Research watchlist only; do not put on a performance leaderboard.

records.title: Multi-objective exploration of multistaged ducted thrusters

method.plasma_model: 2D corona discharge with Poisson space-charge extension

reported_values.note: The article defines thrust density per unit span. It is not area-normalized N/m^2 thrust density.

design_search_limitations: stationary operating conditions for target design
collector airfoil shapes restricted to NACA four-digit parameterisation
constant air density and kinematic viscosity
no physical validation in the article; experiments described as future work
records.data_availability: Underlying data available from corresponding author on reasonable request, not a fully open benchmark dataset.
records.comparability: Computational optimisation comparator. Its N/m thrust-per-span measure must not be compared directly to area-normalized N/m^2. Reported gains are relative to the paper's initial design plan, not independently measured SOTA gains.

comparability_rules: Do not sum or multiply source-local percentage improvements.
Keep thrust, thrust-to-power, thrust density and thrust-to-weight as separate metrics with explicit units.
Keep bare thruster, integrated platform and tethered system boundaries separate.
Keep article abstract transcriptions separate from full-article/raw-data transcriptions.
A missing condition remains null; do not infer it from another paper.
Treat online-ahead-of-issue modelling as a watchlist entry until publication status and model/measurement provenance are reconciled.
The Shibata 2026 multistage ducted optimization reports thrust per span in N/m; do not equate this with area-normalized thrust density in N/m^2.
Numerically optimized geometry is not an experimentally validated propulsion improvement; retain simulation and physical evidence classes.
